evidence_lines: Overdue (delinquent) loan («хугацаа хэтэрсэн зээл»): Loan in the active portfolio with days past due > 5: WHERE is_active_portfolio AND days_past_due > 5. gold: SELECT b.branch_name, COUNT(*) AS overdue_loans FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history h JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.loan_id = h.loan_id JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = l.branch_id WHERE h.snapshot_date = '2026-03-31' AND h.days_past_due > 5 GROUP BY b.branch_name

evidence_lines: Portfolio at risk > 30 days (%) («PAR30»): PAR30 (threshold 45 days) = SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) of loans with days_past_due > 45 / SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) of the active portfolio × 100 (0 for groups without such loans). By principal, not by loan count; both sums WHERE is_active_portfolio. Use exactly: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE days_past_due > 45), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio
gold: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.days_past_due > 45) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS par30_pct FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 100 ORDER BY par30_pct DESC, p.product_id LIMIT 3

evidence_lines: Portfolio at risk > 30 days (%) («PAR30»): PAR30 (threshold 45 days) = SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) of loans with days_past_due > 45 / SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) of the active portfolio × 100 (0 for groups without such loans). gold: WITH br AS (SELECT b.branch_name, 100.0 * SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.days_past_due > 45) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0) AS par30 FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = l.branch_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY b.branch_name), total AS (SELECT 100.0 * SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE days_past_due > 45) / NULLIF(SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt), 0) AS par30 FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio) SELECT br.branch_name, ROUND(br.par30, 2) AS par30_pct FROM br CROSS JOIN total WHERE br.par30 > total.par30

gold: WITH t AS (SELECT p.product_type_code, 100.0 * SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.days_past_due > 45) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0) AS par30 FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY p.product_type_code ORDER BY par30 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) SELECT l.loan_number, l.days_past_due, l.principal_outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id JOIN t ON t.product_type_code = p.product_type_code WHERE l.is_active_portfolio ORDER BY l.days_past_due DESC, l.loan_number LIMIT 3
